name: rack-lat-stretch
instructions:
1. In an upright position, reach forward and grasp a squat rack with one hand. Place your free hand on the ribcage to monitor spinal positioning.
2. Sit back into your hips and step back with the ipsilateral leg to increase the stretch on lats.
3. Slowly lean back and open your hips to intensify the stretch.
4. Hold for time, breaths, or repetitions and repeat on the opposite arm.
